correctness.rationale: The published generator matrix of the new \([22,10,9]_4\) Hermitian LCD code was independently reconstructed over \(\mathbb F_4\). Enumerating all \(4^{10}=1,048,576\) messages reproduced every coefficient of the stated Hamming weight enumerator and minimum weight nine. The Hermitian Gram matrix has rank ten. Independently testing all \(74,613\) six-column subsets found none dependent, while exactly 88 of the \(170,544\) seven-column subsets have rank six. Hence the Euclidean dual distance is seven, and conjugation gives the same Hermitian-dual distance. A separate MacWilliams computation gives \(A_6^\perp=0\) and \(A_7^\perp=264\), agreeing with the circuit count and implying orthogonal-array strength six.
residual_risks: The proof is exhaustive finite computation; it does not classify all inequivalent codes with the same parameters.
